display.purpose: Page H1 on contact and about; integration H1 runs the same steps, fluid at lg as clamp(3.75rem, 5.6vw, 5rem).

display-two-tier.purpose: Homepage H1: light Slate tier over bold Ink tier.

body-reading.purpose: Legal reading; the text column fills the page container beside the contents rail (owner, 2026-11-09).

figure.purpose: Tabular numerals; poster scale on the about band.

micro-label.purpose: 0.625rem uppercase 0.08em English line inside paper document objects only; never above a heading.

figure-offer.purpose: A single offer figure in teal-700 inside a paper door, ruled off with the double teal underline; white at poster scale on the growth closing band.

shadows.name: object-on-field
shadows.purpose: Closing certificate and paper objects on a field (up to 0 32px 60px -28px rgba(5,42,37,0.6)).

shadows.name: double-hairline
shadows.purpose: The document frame's inner hairline, with a 1px teal-200 border.

shadows.name: seal-ring
shadows.purpose: Not elevation: the teal gap and white hairline around a partner seal or partner plate on teal.

shadows.name: seal-drop
shadows.purpose: The play seal resting on a video poster; the free seal on the textbook spread uses it at 0.45.

shadows.name: spread-rest
shadows.purpose: Observed drift, not a rule: the student features spreads at rest on paper.

shadows.name: fold-shade
shadows.value: linear-gradient(to spine, transparent calc(100% - 1.25rem), rgb(5 42 37 / 0.07)) on the textbook page, 0.05 on the VoM page
shadows.purpose: Not elevation: the textbook spread's fold shade on each page's spine edge, mirrored in RTL.

shadows.name: stamped-seal
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 3px currentColor, inset 0 0 0 7px var(--seal-ground), inset 0 0 0 8px currentColor, 0 16px 30px -14px rgb(5 42 37 / 0.55)
shadows.purpose: The sector seal hung on its photo plate: three inset rings on the seal ground, then the drop.

shadows.name: client-seal-ring
shadows.purpose: Client seals' double ring drawn outside the disc; the trailing drop at rest is observed drift, not a rule.

motion.name: anchor-landed
motion.value: 3.2s ease-out teal-50 wash fading to clear

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global prefers-reduced-motion fallback; resting styles are the finished state.

motion.name: disc-draw
motion.value: stroke-dashoffset 1 to 0 on pathLength 1; baseline 0.4s from 0.2s, arrow 0.6s from 0.85s, ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Growth disc baseline and arrow drawing once on load.

motion.name: disc-bar
motion.value: scaleY 0 to 1 from the bar's base (transform-box fill-box), 0.6s ease-out-quint, staggered 0.1s from 0.4s
motion.purpose: Growth disc bars rising once on load.

motion.name: screen-lift
motion.value: translateY 1.5rem to 0 with the shadow lengthening, 0.9s ease-out-quint from 0.1s
motion.purpose: Integration pages' signature: the video screen lifting onto the field once on load.

motion.name: play-stamp
motion.value: opacity 0 and scale 1.35 to rest, 0.5s ease-out-quint from 0.75s
motion.purpose: The play seal stamping in after the screen lands.

motion.name: spread-lift
motion.value: translateY 1.5rem to 0 with the shadow lengthening to object-on-field, 0.8s ease-out-quint from 0.1s
motion.purpose: Student package signature: the textbook spread lifting onto the field once on load.

motion.name: row-write
motion.value: clip-path inset from the reading start (mirrored in RTL), 0.4s ease-out-quint per cell, cells staggered 0.07s; rows from 0.45s and 0.6s, totals row from 0.78s
motion.purpose: The VoM record's cells writing in after the spread lands, the totals closing on the double rule.

motion.name: seal-stamp
motion.value: opacity 0 and scale 1.35 to rest, 0.45s ease-out-quint from 1.05s
motion.purpose: The free seal stamping onto the spread last.

motion.name: sector-lift
motion.value: the shared screen-lift: translateY 1.5rem to 0 with the shadow lengthening, 0.9s ease-out-quint from 0.1s
motion.purpose: Sector pages: the photo plate lifting onto the field once on load.

motion.name: sec-stamp
motion.value: opacity 0 and scale 1.12 to rest, 0.45s ease-out-quint from 0.75s
motion.purpose: The sector seal stamping onto the photo plate after it lands.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Official Record" (الوثيقة)**

Every page is a document VoM issues to the visitor. The ground is white paper; authority arrives as one unbroken field of brand teal engraved with a fine guilloche, the lattice of certificates and banknotes. Paper objects (invoices, certificates, a sealed envelope, framed sheets) sit on that field with the precision of a government form: rounded double-hairline frames, double-ring seals, serial numbers, tabular numerals, a bilingual English line under the Arabic one. Effra sets everything, Arabic, Latin and digits alike, and the layout is built right-to-left first with every component mirrored for English.

The system is restrained by rule. Each page gets one signature idea (the document stack issuing itself on the homepage, the envelope opening on contact, the figures rolling on about, the scroll-spy contents on terms, the growth disc drawing its chart on the growth program, the screen lifting onto the field and its play seal stamping in on the integration pages, the textbook spread on the student package, where one entry as the textbook prints it faces the VoM record it becomes and the record writes itself in, the sector's own seal stamped onto its own photo on the fifteen sector pages) and the rest of the page stays quiet around it. Orange is the single hot colour and marks the one thing to press or the one "now". Buttons are small, precise pills. Sections alternate paper, the light paper-100 grey, and teal bands; depth is mostly tonal, with long teal-tinted shadows reserved for paper objects lifted off a field.

The reading register, introduced by the terms and conditions page, is the same world at its quietest: no field, no guilloche, no buttons, only paper, near-black ink, paper-200 hairlines and teal used as a marker on numerals and the active place in the contents.
keyCharacteristics: Paper white ground, brand-teal fields carrying a fine white guilloche, and nothing engraved on paper.
Double hairlines everywhere authority is claimed: frames, seals, postmarks, the accountant's double rule under totals.
Effra only, in four weights (300, 400, 500, 700), with tabular numerals for every figure.
Small pill buttons; orange only on the primary action.
One orchestrated motion per page on load, with a reduced-motion fallback that removes it.
Arabic RTL first; slanted field edges, transforms and arrows flip for LTR.

rules.name: The One Hot Colour Rule
rules.body: Orange marks the single action to take or the single "now" (today's tick, the latest milestone). It is never a background field, a heading colour or decoration.

rules.name: The Guilloche-on-Teal Rule
rules.body: The guilloche is drawn in white at 10 to 14% opacity on teal fields only. Never on paper, on paper objects, on seals or on the reading register.

rules.name: The Book-in-Slate Rule
rules.body: On a textbook spread the textbook page is the book's, so it is printed in Slate and Graphite on Cool Paper with ink-300 and paper-300 hairlines and no teal; teal, the double hairline and the double teal rule belong to the facing VoM page. The book's own total keeps its accountant's double rule, drawn 3px in Graphite.

rules.name: The White-on-Teal Rule
rules.body: Text on a teal band is white (owner decision). At `teal` this measures about 2.4:1, below the AA floor in CLAUDE.md; this is an open conflict, not a validated pairing (see Do's and Don'ts).

rules.name: The Effra Only Rule
rules.body: One family, loaded through `next/font/local`, weights 300, 400, 500 and 700. No second face, no third-party font link.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Every number that can be compared (amounts, serials, dates, counts, clause numbers) is tabular and set `dir="ltr"` inside Arabic text.

rules.name: The Teal Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted with Shadow Teal, never neutral grey, and belong to paper documents, overlays and hover states. Sections, tiles and frames at rest stay flat.

dos: **Do** keep the brand palette pinned: tints and shades of teal, orange, blue, near-black, the two greys and the light grey only, through the theme tokens.

**Do** give each page one signature idea and one orchestrated motion on load (integration pages: the screen lifts 0.9s from 0.1s, then the play seal stamps 0.5s from 0.75s; student package: the spread lifts 0.8s from 0.1s, the record writes in from 0.45s, the seal stamps 0.45s from 1.05s; sector pages: the photo plate lifts 0.9s from 0.1s, then the sector seal stamps 0.45s from 0.75s), using `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`, with every resting style being the finished state so reduced motion loses nothing.
**Do** frame paper objects with the double hairline and certify with double-ring seals; rule off totals with the 4px double teal underline.
**Do** cut teal fields with a slanted edge and mirror the slant, the arrows and any transform in RTL.
**Do** set the English micro-label (0.625rem, uppercase, 0.08em tracking) only inside paper document objects, as the English line of an official form or a corner stamp.
**Do** label demonstration data in every mock-up.
**Do** print a textbook page in Slate on Cool Paper with no teal and no frame, and give teal, the double hairline and the double teal rule to the facing VoM page.
**Do** switch the focus outline to white on any teal ground.
**Do** set partner and third-party logos on a white seal disc on teal, or on the ringed white plate when the mark is a wordmark too wide for a disc, never directly on the field.
**Do** draw partner marks at the context height times the mark's optical scale, so no partner outweighs another.
**Do** use the reading register (no field, no guilloche, no buttons, teal only as a marker) for long documents.
**Do** draw seal rings as inset shadows on a `--seal-ground` that matches the surface the seal sits on, so the gap between the rings is always the ground.

**Do** draw icons repeated across a page (clause icons, register pictograms) in CSS pseudo-elements from data attributes, and serve repeated small images through one optimizer URL without a srcset, to keep the HTML inside its budget.
**Do** pre-set third-party logos on a common square canvas at an equal optical size, so one width fits every seal.
donts: **Don't** put orange on anything but the primary action or the single "now" marker.
**Don't** draw the guilloche on paper, on paper objects, on seals or in the reading register.
**Don't** add a second typeface or load Effra from a third-party link.
**Don't** use neutral grey shadows, or shadow sections, tiles and frames at rest.
**Don't** place a micro-label or any small line above a heading as a kicker or eyebrow.
**Don't** treat Mist (`ink-300`) as a text colour for content that must be read, or treat white on Record Teal and white on Action Orange as meeting AA; both measure below 3:1 and are open items.
